# Contributing

## Commits

- One change per pull request. PRs are squash-merged, so the PR title becomes the commit on `main`. Write it as `<type>: <description>`, under 72 characters.
- Types: `feat` (new behaviour), `fix` (bug fix), `security`, `refactor`, `test`, `docs`, `ci`, `chore`. Only `feat`, `fix` and `security` go into the release notes, so pick the type a user would care about.
- Inside the PR, keep the commits in meaningful steps that are easy to review one by one. Squash fix-ups ("fix typo", "address review") into the commit they belong to rather than keeping your development history.
- After pushing or editing the description during review, leave a short comment saying what changed.
